Nafion 117 ionomer membrane used in the process

nodes.name: 3D printing hierarchical Ni PTL
nodes.procedure: The ink, composed of nickel oxide (NiO) and polymethyl methacrylate (PMMA), exhibited shear-thinning behavior, facilitating smooth extrusion through the nozzle. The printed PTL was then subjected to heat treatment to achieve the final morphology.
nodes.source_text: a PTL fabricated using DIW formed hierarchical grid gradients... The printed PTL was then subjected to heat treatment

nodes.name: Laser synthesis Mo2C micropillars
nodes.procedure: Mo foil substrates were ablated using a focused laser beam in a methane (CH4) atmosphere to synthesize Mo2C micropillars.
nodes.source_text: laser ablation synthesis of molybdenum carbide (Mo2C) micropillars... in a methane (CH4) atmosphere

nodes.name: Pt deposition and reduction
nodes.procedure: The Mo substrate was then immersed in a hexachloroplatinic acid (H2PtCl6) solution, allowing Pt^4+ to adsorb onto the surface of the micropillars. An under-focused laser beam was used to reduce the Pt^4+ ions to platinum in an argon/hydrogen (Ar/H2) atmosphere.
nodes.source_text: Pt ion deposition, and laser-induced reduction of platinum ions... in an argon/hydrogen (Ar/H2) atmosphere

nodes.name: NiFeP on graphene/CNT PTL
nodes.procedure: a hierarchical porous PTL was fabricated using an extrusion-based 3D printing with a ink of graphene reinforced with carbon nanotubes (CNTs). After freeze-drying and annealing, the cured PTL served as an ideal support for uniform loading of NiFeP nanosheets catalysts via hydrothermal and phosphorization treatment.
nodes.source_text: Direct ink writing (DIW) enables the creation of carbon-based catalyst-integrated ordered PTLs... via hydrothermal and phosphorization treatment

nodes.name: C-Ni1-xO nanorod growth
nodes.procedure: Kou et al. utilize DIW to construct a 3D lattice catalyst-integrated ordered PTL, using an ink composed of Ni microparticles and swollen polymers. Nickel oxalate dihydrate crystals were grown on these structures via anodization and converted into C-Ni1-xO nanorods through thermal treatment.
nodes.source_text: Nickel oxalate dihydrate crystals were grown... via anodization and converted into C-Ni1-xO nanorods through thermal treatment

nodes.name: Polymer infusion metal framework
nodes.procedure: The scaffolds were then infiltrated with a precursor solution containing nickel nitrate (Ni(NO3)2) or cobalt nitrate (Co(NO3)2). After infiltration, the template was subjected to a calcination process at 450°C and then reduced in a hydrogen atmosphere to convert it into a conductive metal framework.
nodes.source_text: calcination process at 450°C and then reduced in a hydrogen atmosphere

nodes.name: IrO2 inverse opal electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: an inverse-opal-structured CL can be created using a colloidal crystal template followed by pulse electrodeposition to fill the template voids with IrO2. The colloidal crystal template is then removed.
nodes.source_text: colloidal crystal template followed by pulse electrodeposition to fill the template voids with IrO2

nodes.name: TiO2/Nafion hybrid ordered array
nodes.procedure: Zhou et al. constructed a new hybridized ordered array membrane by doping TiO2 particles in the Nafion emulsion. The inclusion of TiO2 particles increased the surface roughness of the ordered array membrane.
nodes.source_text: Zhou et al. constructed a new hybridized ordered array membrane by doping TiO2 particles in the Nafion emulsion

nodes.name: Nafion cone array casting
nodes.procedure: Zhou et al. cast the Nafion emulsion into a porous AAO template and then compounded it with a commercial Nafion 115 membrane to obtain a membrane with ordered array on the surface.
nodes.source_text: Zhou et al. cast the Nafion emulsion into a porous AAO template... to obtain a membrane with ordered array

nodes.name: Tapered Nafion hot-pressing
nodes.procedure: 1) Filling catalyst ink into a template with ordered holes; 2) Hot-pressing the membrane into the template; and 3) Removing the template to obtain the ordered CL. A membrane with cathodic CL was then hot-pressed onto the template, allowing the ink to fill the template holes.
nodes.source_text: The hot-pressing method involves: 1) Filling catalyst ink into a template... yielding an ordered anodic CL

nodes.name: Woodpile Ir nanotransfer printing
nodes.procedure: The WP structure is fabricated using repeating solvent-assisted nanotransfer printing, allowing precise control over the spacing and alignment of nanowires.
nodes.source_text: stack-printed ordered CL demonstrates a 3D woodpile (WP) structure... using repeating solvent-assisted nanotransfer printing

nodes.name: 2D patterned CL shadow mask
nodes.procedure: The shadow mask method has been used to create 2D-patterned CL with a regular array of catalytic sites.
nodes.source_text: The shadow mask method, for instance, has been used to create 2D-patterned CL
